name: agres
description: Project memory + Origami context folding for Claude Code. Hooks inject decisions, rejections, constraints, open work and handoffs at session start and after /compact; big Bash output is folded out of the window and unfolded exactly by ID. Local SQLite per repo, stdlib Python.

capture.title: Conversation capture
capture.description: Store prompts and replies (all), prompts only, or nothing. Decisions and other items are always kept.

turn_retention_days.title: Keep captured turns (days)
turn_retention_days.description: Delete captured turns and raw tool folds older than this at session end. 0 keeps them forever.

budget_chars.title: Memory block size (chars)
budget_chars.description: Size of the memory injected at session start and after /compact.

fold.title: Origami folding
fold.description: Fold big Bash output out of the context window (exact text stays one `agres unfold F<id>` away).

fold_chars.title: Fold threshold (chars)
fold_chars.description: Fold a Bash stdout/stderr longer than this.
